context: SQL from absolute zero to reading execution plans. Favor predict-the-output, choose-the-query, spot-the-bug examples. Center window functions, join fan-out pitfalls, and query plans. Bridge topics: B-tree index vs inverted search index; ACID and OLTP-vs-OLAP as workload categories.
